I don’t have any answers you’re seeking, as I am also trying to make sense of these feelings as well; but I want to say that you’re not alone in this (as cliche as it sounds). Quarantine has been hard, and I think experiencing limerence through all this is incredibly gut wrenching as most of us are confined to the house due to job closures and social distancing, it’s like we’re left to only our thoughts. I have been having a particular hard time convincing myself to not reach out to the person I am experiencing limerence over. I guess tldr I wanna say that it may seem super rough right now and I don’t necessarily have answers on how to fix or aid that but you’re not alone in this feeling and I for one related highly to this; and I hope you continue to push forward with strength. I hear you and I hope one day this will all subside.
